fr.title: Lire le Beige Book : pourquoi le rapport anecdotique de la Fed relie des prix tenaces aux droits de douane, à la guerre et aux dépenses liées à l'IA

segments.src: Eight times a year, the Federal Reserve publishes a document that looks nothing like a typical economic release.
segments.tr: Huit fois par an, la Réserve fédérale publie un document qui ressemble très peu à une publication économique classique.

segments.src: There are no charts full of decimal points and no single headline number.
segments.tr: Pas de graphiques remplis de décimales ni de chiffre phare unique.

segments.src: Instead, the Beige Book is a plain-language collection of stories from business owners, bankers and community contacts across the country.
segments.tr: Le Beige Book est plutôt un recueil de témoignages rédigés en langage courant, émanant de chefs d'entreprise, de banquiers et de contacts locaux à travers le pays.

segments.src: The latest edition draws attention because several of those stories point the same way: prices are proving harder to tame, and contacts keep naming three sources of pressure, which are tariffs, the conflict involving Iran and the boom in AI-related construction and equipment.
segments.tr: La dernière édition attire l'attention parce que plusieurs de ces témoignages vont dans le même sens : les prix résistent davantage à la modération, et les contacts citent sans cesse trois sources de pression, à savoir les droits de douane, le conflit impliquant l'Iran et le boom de la construction et des équipements liés à l'IA.

segments.src: This article explains what the Beige Book is, why it matters even though it is not "hard data," and how to read its themes without overreading them.
segments.tr: Cet article explique ce qu'est le Beige Book, pourquoi il compte malgré le fait qu'il ne s'agit pas de « données brutes », et comment lire ses thèmes sans en tirer des conclusions excessives.

segments.src: ## What the Beige Book actually is
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'est réellement le Beige Book

segments.src: The Beige Book's formal title is the *Summary of Commentary on Current Economic Conditions by Federal Reserve District*.
segments.tr: Le titre officiel du Beige Book est *Synthèse des commentaires sur la conjoncture économique actuelle par district de la Réserve fédérale*.

segments.src: It is compiled by the 12 regional Federal Reserve Banks, each covering its own part of the country.
segments.tr: Il est compilé par les 12 banques régionales de la Réserve fédérale, chacune couvrant sa propre partie du pays.

segments.src: Staff at each Bank talk with business executives, economists, market experts and other contacts, then summarize what they hear.
segments.tr: Le personnel de chaque banque s'entretient avec des dirigeants d'entreprise, des économistes, des experts de marché et d'autres contacts, puis résume ce qu'il entend.

segments.src: The reports are combined into a national overview and released about two weeks before each meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), the group that sets interest rate policy.
segments.tr: Les rapports sont regroupés en une vue d'ensemble nationale et publiés environ deux semaines avant chaque réunion du Comité fédéral de l'open market (FOMC), l'organe qui définit la politique de taux d'intérêt.

segments.src: Key features:
segments.tr: Caractéristiques principales :

segments.src: - **It is qualitative.** The text describes conditions as "modest," "moderate," "slight" or "strong" rather than giving precise measurements.
segments.tr: - **Il est qualitatif.** Le texte décrit la conjoncture par des termes tels que « modeste », « modérée », « légère » ou « forte », plutôt que par des mesures précises.

segments.src: - **It is anecdotal by design.** The value lies in firsthand accounts: what a manufacturer is paying for steel, what a retailer plans to do about shelf prices, what a lender sees in loan demand.
segments.tr: - **Il est anecdotique par conception.** Sa valeur réside dans les témoignages de première main : ce qu'un fabricant paie pour l'acier, ce qu'un détaillant prévoit de faire concernant les prix en rayon, ce qu'un prêteur observe dans la demande de crédit.

segments.src: - **It is timely.** Government statistics often arrive with a lag and are revised later. The Beige Book captures sentiment as it forms.
segments.tr: - **Il est opportun.** Les statistiques publiques arrivent souvent avec un décalage et sont révisées ultérieurement. Le Beige Book saisit le sentiment au moment où il se forme.

segments.src: - **It is regional.** National averages can hide differences. A port-heavy district may feel tariffs differently than a farm-heavy one.
segments.tr: - **Il est régional.** Les moyennes nationales peuvent masquer des différences. Un district à forte activité portuaire peut ressentir les droits de douane différemment d'un district agricole.

segments.src: ## How it differs from hard data
segments.tr: ## En quoi il diffère des données brutes

segments.src: Official data such as the Consumer Price Index (CPI), the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index and the jobs report are built from large, systematic surveys and statistical methods.
segments.tr: Les données officielles, comme l'indice des prix à la consommation (CPI), l'indice des prix des dépenses de consommation personnelle (PCE) et le rapport sur l'emploi, reposent sur de vastes enquêtes systématiques et des méthodes statistiques.

segments.src: They can be compared month to month and year to year.
segments.tr: Elles peuvent être comparées d'un mois à l'autre et d'une année à l'autre.

segments.src: That is their strength.
segments.tr: C'est là leur force.

segments.src: The Beige Book trades precision for context.
segments.tr: Le Beige Book sacrifie la précision au profit du contexte.

segments.src: Hard data tells policymakers *how much* prices rose.
segments.tr: Les données brutes indiquent aux décideurs *dans quelle mesure* les prix ont augmenté.

segments.src: The Beige Book helps explain *why* businesses say they are raising them and *whether they expect to keep doing so*.
segments.tr: Le Beige Book aide à expliquer *pourquoi* les entreprises disent les relever et *si elles comptent continuer à le faire*.

segments.src: | | Hard data (CPI, PCE, jobs) | Beige Book |
segments.tr: | | Données brutes (CPI, PCE, emploi) | Beige Book |

segments.src: | Form | Numbers and indexes | Narrative summaries |
segments.tr: | Forme | Chiffres et indices | Synthèses narratives |

segments.src: | Method | Statistical sampling | Interviews and conversations |
segments.tr: | Méthode | Échantillonnage statistique | Entretiens et échanges |

segments.src: | Strength | Comparable and measurable | Timely and explanatory |
segments.tr: | Force | Comparables et mesurables | Opportun et explicatif |

segments.src: | Weakness | Lagging and revised | Subjective and hard to quantify |
segments.tr: | Faiblesse | Décalé et révisé | Subjectif et difficile à quantifier |

segments.src: Neither source is better on its own.
segments.tr: Aucune des deux sources n'est meilleure à elle seule.

segments.src: Policymakers use both, and the Beige Book often works as a cross-check.
segments.tr: Les décideurs utilisent les deux, et le Beige Book sert souvent de contre-vérification.

segments.src: If the numbers and the stories agree, confidence rises.
segments.tr: Si les chiffres et les témoignages concordent, la confiance augmente.

segments.src: If they diverge, that is a reason to look closer.
segments.tr: S'ils divergent, cela constitue une raison d'examiner de plus près.

segments.src: ## The three pressures contacts keep naming
segments.tr: ## Les trois pressions que les contacts citent sans cesse

segments.src: ### 1. Tariffs
segments.tr: ### 1. Droits de douane

segments.src: Businesses in many districts have described import taxes as a direct cost.
segments.tr: Les entreprises de nombreux districts décrivent les taxes à l'importation comme un coût direct.

segments.src: The pattern commonly reported is that firms first absorb higher input costs, then pass part of them to customers, often in stages.
segments.tr: Le schéma le plus souvent rapporté est le suivant : les entreprises absorbent d'abord la hausse des coûts d'intrants, puis en répercutent une partie sur leurs clients, souvent par étapes.

segments.src: Some contacts say they have diversified suppliers, but switching sources takes time and can itself raise costs.
segments.tr: Certains contacts disent avoir diversifié leurs fournisseurs, mais changer de source prend du temps et peut lui-même augmenter les coûts.

segments.src: Because tariffs affect goods that feed into other goods, the effect can show up well beyond the imported item itself.
segments.tr: Comme les droits de douane touchent des biens qui entrent dans la fabrication d'autres biens, l'effet peut se manifester bien au-delà du seul article importé.

segments.src: ### 2. The Iran conflict
segments.tr: ### 2. Le conflit iranien

segments.src: Geopolitical conflict affects prices mainly through energy and shipping.
segments.tr: Les conflits géopolitiques affectent les prix principalement par l'énergie et le transport maritime.

segments.src: When tensions threaten oil supply or raise insurance and rerouting costs for freight, fuel and transportation expenses rise, and those costs are embedded in nearly everything that is made or moved.
segments.tr: Lorsque les tensions menacent l'approvisionnement en pétrole ou augmentent les primes d'assurance et les coûts de réacheminement du fret, les dépenses de carburant et de transport augmentent, et ces coûts entrent dans presque tout ce qui est fabriqué ou transporté.

segments.src: Contacts who report higher fuel or logistics bills tend to describe them as hard to predict, which makes long-term pricing decisions harder.
segments.tr: Les contacts qui signalent une hausse de leurs factures de carburant ou de logistique ont tendance à les décrire comme difficiles à prévoir, ce qui complique les décisions de tarification à long terme.

segments.src: ### 3. The AI building boom
segments.tr: ### 3. Le boom de la construction liée à l'IA

segments.src: The rush to build data centers and buy computing hardware is a different kind of pressure.
segments.tr: La course à la construction de centres de données et à l'achat de matériel informatique représente un type de pression différent.

segments.src: It is demand-driven rather than supply-driven.
segments.tr: Elle est tirée par la demande plutôt que par l'offre.

segments.src: Large projects compete for electricians, construction materials, electrical equipment and power capacity.
segments.tr: Les grands projets se disputent électriciens, matériaux de construction, équipements électriques et capacité électrique.

segments.src: In districts with heavy data center activity, contacts describe tighter supplies and higher costs for those inputs, and the effects can spill over to other builders and local utilities.
segments.tr: Dans les districts où les centres de données sont très actifs, les contacts décrivent des approvisionnements plus tendus et des coûts plus élevés pour ces intrants, et les effets peuvent se répercuter sur d'autres constructeurs et sur les services publics locaux.

segments.src: ## What businesses are telling the central bank
segments.tr: ## Ce que les entreprises disent à la banque centrale

segments.src: Across these themes, the message in the report is less about a single shock than about layering.
segments.tr: Au-delà de ces thèmes, le message du rapport porte moins sur un choc unique que sur un effet de superposition.

segments.src: Each source of cost pressure is manageable on its own.
segments.tr: Chaque source de pression sur les coûts est gérable isolément.

segments.src: Together, they make it harder for firms to say that price increases are behind them.
segments.tr: Ensemble, elles rendent plus difficile pour les entreprises d'affirmer que les hausses de prix sont derrière elles.

segments.src: Common threads in this kind of commentary include:
segments.tr: Les fils conducteurs de ce type de commentaires comprennent notamment :

segments.src: - Firms say they are passing through costs more selectively, since consumers have become more price-sensitive.
segments.tr: - Les entreprises affirment répercuter les coûts de manière plus sélective, les consommateurs étant devenus plus sensibles aux prix.

segments.src: - Many describe uncertainty as the main obstacle to planning, which can delay hiring and investment.
segments.tr: - Beaucoup décrivent l'incertitude comme le principal obstacle à la planification, ce qui peut retarder les embauches et les investissements.

segments.src: - Wage pressure is often described as moderate, which may limit how much cost growth is built into prices from the labor side.
segments.tr: - La pression salariale est souvent décrite comme modérée, ce qui peut limiter la part de hausse des coûts intégrée aux prix du côté du travail.

segments.src: - Consumers are described as shifting toward discounts and cheaper options, especially lower- and middle-income households.
segments.tr: - Les consommateurs sont décrits comme se tournant vers les promotions et les options moins chères, en particulier les ménages à revenus faibles et intermédiaires.

segments.src: Readers should check the full text of the latest release on the Federal Reserve's website, since the emphasis varies from district to district and edition to edition.
segments.tr: Les lecteurs doivent consulter le texte intégral de la dernière publication sur le site de la Réserve fédérale, car l'accent varie d'un district à l'autre et d'une édition à l'autre.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for interest rates
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi c'est important pour les taux d'intérêt

segments.src: The Fed's job is to balance stable prices against maximum employment.
segments.tr: La mission de la Fed consiste à concilier stabilité des prix et emploi maximal.

segments.src: When inflation stays above target while the labor market cools, that balance gets difficult.
segments.tr: Lorsque l'inflation reste au-dessus de la cible alors que le marché du travail se refroidit, cet équilibre devient difficile à tenir.

segments.src: A Beige Book that describes persistent price pressure gives policymakers a reason to be cautious about cutting rates too quickly.
segments.tr: Un Beige Book qui décrit une pression persistante sur les prix donne aux décideurs une raison d'être prudents quant à une baisse trop rapide des taux.

segments.src: A Beige Book that shows weakening demand and fading pricing power can argue the other way.
segments.tr: Un Beige Book qui montre un affaiblissement de la demande et une perte du pouvoir de fixation des prix peut plaider dans l'autre sens.

segments.src: The report does not set policy.
segments.tr: Le rapport ne fixe pas la politique monétaire.

segments.src: It is one input among many, alongside inflation readings, employment data, financial conditions and the FOMC's own projections.
segments.tr: Il ne constitue qu'un élément parmi d'autres, aux côtés des indicateurs d'inflation, des données sur l'emploi, des conditions financières et des projections propres au FOMC.

segments.src: ## How to read it sensibly
segments.tr: ## Comment le lire avec discernement

segments.src: 1. **Look for repeated themes, not single quotes.** One company's experience is an anecdote. The same story from several districts is a signal.
segments.tr: 1. **Recherchez les thèmes récurrents, pas les citations isolées.** L'expérience d'une seule entreprise est une anecdote. Le même constat dans plusieurs districts constitue un signal.

segments.src: 2. **Notice changes in wording.** A move from "modest" to "moderate" price growth is small but meaningful in context.
segments.tr: 2. **Remarquez les changements de formulation.** Passer de « modeste » à « modérée » pour la hausse des prix est un changement minime mais significatif dans son contexte.

segments.src: 3. **Compare with hard data.** See whether the latest CPI and PCE figures are consistent with what contacts report.
segments.tr: 3. **Comparez avec les données brutes.** Vérifiez si les derniers chiffres du CPI et du PCE sont cohérents avec ce que rapportent les contacts.

segments.src: 4. **Remember its limits.** Contacts are not a random sample, and sentiment can shift quickly.
segments.tr: 4. **Gardez à l'esprit ses limites.** Les contacts ne constituent pas un échantillon aléatoire, et le sentiment peut évoluer rapidement.

segments.src: ## The takeaway
segments.tr: ## En bref

segments.src: The Beige Book will not tell you the exact path of inflation or interest rates.
segments.tr: Le Beige Book ne vous dira pas la trajectoire exacte de l'inflation ou des taux d'intérêt.

segments.src: What it does offer is a view from the ground, and the latest one suggests businesses see several overlapping reasons why prices are not settling down: trade policy, geopolitical risk and a surge in AI-related investment.
segments.tr: Ce qu'il offre, en revanche, c'est un regard depuis le terrain, et la dernière édition suggère que les entreprises voient plusieurs raisons qui se chevauchent pour lesquelles les prix ne se stabilisent pas : la politique commerciale, les risques géopolitiques et une forte hausse des investissements liés à l'IA.

segments.src: Whether those pressures fade or persist will show up in the data in coming months.
segments.tr: Que ces pressions s'atténuent ou persistent apparaîtra dans les données des mois à venir.

segments.src: If the numbers and the stories agree, confidence rises.

segments.src: ## The three pressures contacts keep naming
segments.tr: ## As três pressões que os contatos continuam citando

segments.src: ### 1. Tariffs
segments.tr: ### 1. Tarifas

segments.src: Businesses in many districts have described import taxes as a direct cost.
segments.tr: Empresas de muitos distritos descreveram os impostos de importação como um custo direto.

segments.src: The pattern commonly reported is that firms first absorb higher input costs, then pass part of them to customers, often in stages.
segments.tr: O padrão mais relatado é que as empresas primeiro absorvem o aumento dos custos de insumos e depois repassam parte deles aos clientes, muitas vezes em etapas.

segments.src: Some contacts say they have diversified suppliers, but switching sources takes time and can itself raise costs.
segments.tr: Alguns contatos dizem ter diversificado fornecedores, mas trocar de fonte leva tempo e pode, por si só, elevar custos.

segments.src: Because tariffs affect goods that feed into other goods, the effect can show up well beyond the imported item itself.
segments.tr: Como as tarifas afetam bens que entram na produção de outros bens, o efeito pode aparecer muito além do item importado em si.

segments.src: ### 2. The Iran conflict
segments.tr: ### 2. O conflito com o Irã

segments.src: Geopolitical conflict affects prices mainly through energy and shipping.
segments.tr: Conflitos geopolíticos afetam os preços principalmente por meio de energia e transporte marítimo.

segments.src: When tensions threaten oil supply or raise insurance and rerouting costs for freight, fuel and transportation expenses rise, and those costs are embedded in nearly everything that is made or moved.
segments.tr: Quando as tensões ameaçam o fornecimento de petróleo ou elevam os custos de seguro e de desvio de rotas no frete, as despesas com combustível e transporte sobem, e esses custos estão embutidos em quase tudo que é produzido ou transportado.

segments.src: Contacts who report higher fuel or logistics bills tend to describe them as hard to predict, which makes long-term pricing decisions harder.
segments.tr: Os contatos que relatam contas mais altas de combustível ou logística tendem a descrevê-las como difíceis de prever, o que torna mais complicadas as decisões de precificação de longo prazo.

segments.src: ### 3. The AI building boom
segments.tr: ### 3. O boom de construção para IA

segments.src: The rush to build data centers and buy computing hardware is a different kind of pressure.
segments.tr: A corrida para construir data centers e comprar hardware de computação é uma pressão de outro tipo.

segments.src: It is demand-driven rather than supply-driven.
segments.tr: Ela é impulsionada pela demanda, e não pela oferta.

segments.src: Large projects compete for electricians, construction materials, electrical equipment and power capacity.
segments.tr: Projetos de grande porte disputam eletricistas, materiais de construção, equipamentos elétricos e capacidade de energia.

segments.src: In districts with heavy data center activity, contacts describe tighter supplies and higher costs for those inputs, and the effects can spill over to other builders and local utilities.
segments.tr: Em distritos com forte atividade de data centers, os contatos descrevem oferta mais escassa e custos mais altos para esses insumos, e os efeitos podem se espalhar para outros construtores e para as concessionárias locais de energia.

segments.src: ## What businesses are telling the central bank
segments.tr: ## O que as empresas dizem ao banco central

segments.src: Across these themes, the message in the report is less about a single shock than about layering.
segments.tr: Entre esses temas, a mensagem do relatório diz menos respeito a um choque isolado e mais a um efeito de camadas.

segments.src: Each source of cost pressure is manageable on its own.
segments.tr: Cada fonte de pressão de custos é administrável por si só.

segments.src: Together, they make it harder for firms to say that price increases are behind them.
segments.tr: Juntas, elas dificultam que as empresas digam que os aumentos de preços já ficaram para trás.

segments.src: Common threads in this kind of commentary include:
segments.tr: Entre os fios condutores comuns nesse tipo de comentário estão:

segments.src: - Firms say they are passing through costs more selectively, since consumers have become more price-sensitive.
segments.tr: - As empresas dizem que repassam os custos de forma mais seletiva, já que os consumidores ficaram mais sensíveis a preço.

segments.src: - Many describe uncertainty as the main obstacle to planning, which can delay hiring and investment.
segments.tr: - Muitas descrevem a incerteza como o principal obstáculo ao planejamento, o que pode adiar contratações e investimentos.

segments.src: - Wage pressure is often described as moderate, which may limit how much cost growth is built into prices from the labor side.
segments.tr: - A pressão salarial costuma ser descrita como moderada, o que pode limitar quanto do crescimento de custos do lado do trabalho se incorpora aos preços.

segments.src: - Consumers are described as shifting toward discounts and cheaper options, especially lower- and middle-income households.
segments.tr: - Os consumidores são descritos como migrando para descontos e opções mais baratas, especialmente famílias de renda baixa e média.

segments.src: Readers should check the full text of the latest release on the Federal Reserve's website, since the emphasis varies from district to district and edition to edition.
segments.tr: Os leitores devem consultar o texto completo da edição mais recente no site do Federal Reserve, já que a ênfase varia de distrito para distrito e de edição para edição.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for interest rates
segments.tr: ## Por que importa para os juros

segments.src: The Fed's job is to balance stable prices against maximum employment.
segments.tr: A missão do Fed é equilibrar estabilidade de preços e emprego máximo.

segments.src: When inflation stays above target while the labor market cools, that balance gets difficult.
segments.tr: Quando a inflação permanece acima da meta enquanto o mercado de trabalho esfria, esse equilíbrio se torna difícil.

segments.src: A Beige Book that describes persistent price pressure gives policymakers a reason to be cautious about cutting rates too quickly.
segments.tr: Um Beige Book que descreve pressão persistente sobre preços dá aos formuladores de política um motivo para ser cautelosos quanto a cortar juros rápido demais.

segments.src: A Beige Book that shows weakening demand and fading pricing power can argue the other way.
segments.tr: Já um Beige Book que mostra demanda enfraquecendo e perda de poder de precificação pode sustentar o argumento contrário.

segments.src: The report does not set policy.
segments.tr: O relatório não define a política monetária.

segments.src: It is one input among many, alongside inflation readings, employment data, financial conditions and the FOMC's own projections.
segments.tr: Ele é um insumo entre muitos, ao lado dos indicadores de inflação, dos dados de emprego, das condições financeiras e das próprias projeções do FOMC.

segments.src: ## How to read it sensibly
segments.tr: ## Como lê-lo com sensatez

segments.src: 1. **Look for repeated themes, not single quotes.** One company's experience is an anecdote. The same story from several districts is a signal.
segments.tr: 1. **Procure temas recorrentes, não citações isoladas.** A experiência de uma empresa é uma anedota. A mesma história em vários distritos é um sinal.

segments.src: 2. **Notice changes in wording.** A move from "modest" to "moderate" price growth is small but meaningful in context.
segments.tr: 2. **Observe mudanças na redação.** Passar de “modesto” para “moderado” no crescimento de preços é uma diferença pequena, mas significativa no contexto.

segments.src: 3. **Compare with hard data.** See whether the latest CPI and PCE figures are consistent with what contacts report.
segments.tr: 3. **Compare com os dados concretos.** Verifique se os números mais recentes do CPI e do PCE são coerentes com o que os contatos relatam.

segments.src: 4. **Remember its limits.** Contacts are not a random sample, and sentiment can shift quickly.
segments.tr: 4. **Lembre-se dos limites.** Os contatos não são uma amostra aleatória, e o sentimento pode mudar rapidamente.

segments.src: ## The takeaway
segments.tr: ## A conclusão

segments.src: The Beige Book will not tell you the exact path of inflation or interest rates.
segments.tr: O Beige Book não vai dizer o caminho exato da inflação ou dos juros.

segments.src: What it does offer is a view from the ground, and the latest one suggests businesses see several overlapping reasons why prices are not settling down: trade policy, geopolitical risk and a surge in AI-related investment.
segments.tr: O que ele oferece é uma visão do chão de fábrica, e a edição mais recente sugere que as empresas enxergam vários motivos sobrepostos para os preços não se acomodarem: política comercial, risco geopolítico e uma onda de investimentos ligados à IA.

segments.src: Whether those pressures fade or persist will show up in the data in coming months.
segments.tr: Se essas pressões vão desaparecer ou persistir, isso aparecerá nos dados nos próximos meses.

in.title: Membaca Beige Book: Mengapa Laporan Anekdot The Fed Mengaitkan Harga yang Bandel dengan Tarif, Perang, dan Belanja AI

segments.src: Eight times a year, the Federal Reserve publishes a document that looks nothing like a typical economic release.
segments.tr: Delapan kali setahun, Federal Reserve menerbitkan dokumen yang sama sekali tidak mirip rilis ekonomi pada umumnya.

segments.src: There are no charts full of decimal points and no single headline number.
segments.tr: Tidak ada grafik penuh angka desimal dan tidak ada satu angka utama.

segments.src: Instead, the Beige Book is a plain-language collection of stories from business owners, bankers and community contacts across the country.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, Beige Book adalah kumpulan cerita dalam bahasa sederhana dari pemilik usaha, bankir, dan narasumber komunitas di seluruh negeri.

segments.src: The latest edition draws attention because several of those stories point the same way: prices are proving harder to tame, and contacts keep naming three sources of pressure, which are tariffs, the conflict involving Iran and the boom in AI-related construction and equipment.
segments.tr: Edisi terbaru menarik perhatian karena beberapa cerita itu menunjuk ke arah yang sama: harga semakin sulit dijinakkan, dan narasumber terus menyebut tiga sumber tekanan, yaitu tarif, konflik yang melibatkan Iran, dan ledakan konstruksi serta peralatan terkait AI.

segments.src: This article explains what the Beige Book is, why it matters even though it is not "hard data," and how to read its themes without overreading them.
segments.tr: Artikel ini menjelaskan apa itu Beige Book, mengapa ia penting meskipun bukan "data keras", dan bagaimana membaca tema-temanya tanpa menafsirkannya berlebihan.

segments.src: ## What the Beige Book actually is
segments.tr: ## Apa sebenarnya Beige Book

segments.src: The Beige Book's formal title is the *Summary of Commentary on Current Economic Conditions by Federal Reserve District*.
segments.tr: Judul resmi Beige Book adalah *Summary of Commentary on Current Economic Conditions by Federal Reserve District* (Ringkasan Komentar tentang Kondisi Ekonomi Terkini menurut Distrik Federal Reserve).

segments.src: It is compiled by the 12 regional Federal Reserve Banks, each covering its own part of the country.
segments.tr: Dokumen ini disusun oleh 12 Bank Federal Reserve regional, masing-masing mencakup wilayahnya sendiri di negara ini.

segments.src: Staff at each Bank talk with business executives, economists, market experts and other contacts, then summarize what they hear.
segments.tr: Staf di setiap Bank berbicara dengan eksekutif bisnis, ekonom, pakar pasar, dan narasumber lain, lalu merangkum apa yang mereka dengar.

segments.src: The reports are combined into a national overview and released about two weeks before each meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), the group that sets interest rate policy.
segments.tr: Laporan-laporan itu digabungkan menjadi gambaran nasional dan dirilis sekitar dua minggu sebelum setiap rapat Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), kelompok yang menetapkan kebijakan suku bunga.

segments.src: Key features:
segments.tr: Ciri utamanya:

segments.src: - **It is qualitative.** The text describes conditions as "modest," "moderate," "slight" or "strong" rather than giving precise measurements.
segments.tr: - **Bersifat kualitatif.** Teksnya menggambarkan kondisi dengan istilah seperti "modest" (sederhana), "moderate" (sedang), "slight" (sedikit), atau "strong" (kuat), alih-alih memberikan pengukuran yang presisi.

segments.src: - **It is anecdotal by design.** The value lies in firsthand accounts: what a manufacturer is paying for steel, what a retailer plans to do about shelf prices, what a lender sees in loan demand.
segments.tr: - **Sengaja bersifat anekdotal.** Nilainya ada pada kesaksian langsung: berapa harga baja yang dibayar produsen, apa yang akan dilakukan peritel terhadap harga di rak, atau apa yang dilihat pemberi pinjaman dari permintaan kredit.

segments.src: - **It is timely.** Government statistics often arrive with a lag and are revised later. The Beige Book captures sentiment as it forms.
segments.tr: - **Bersifat tepat waktu.** Statistik pemerintah sering datang terlambat dan direvisi kemudian. Beige Book menangkap sentimen saat sedang terbentuk.

segments.src: - **It is regional.** National averages can hide differences. A port-heavy district may feel tariffs differently than a farm-heavy one.
segments.tr: - **Bersifat regional.** Rata-rata nasional bisa menyembunyikan perbedaan. Distrik yang banyak pelabuhannya mungkin merasakan tarif secara berbeda dibanding distrik yang banyak pertaniannya.

segments.src: ## How it differs from hard data
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana bedanya dengan data keras

segments.src: Official data such as the Consumer Price Index (CPI), the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index and the jobs report are built from large, systematic surveys and statistical methods.
segments.tr: Data resmi seperti Consumer Price Index (CPI), indeks harga Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE), dan laporan ketenagakerjaan disusun dari survei berskala besar dan metode statistik yang sistematis.

segments.src: They can be compared month to month and year to year.
segments.tr: Data itu bisa dibandingkan dari bulan ke bulan dan dari tahun ke tahun.

segments.src: That is their strength.
segments.tr: Di situlah kekuatannya.

segments.src: The Beige Book trades precision for context.
segments.tr: Beige Book menukar presisi dengan konteks.

segments.src: Hard data tells policymakers *how much* prices rose.
segments.tr: Data keras memberi tahu pembuat kebijakan *seberapa besar* harga naik.

segments.src: The Beige Book helps explain *why* businesses say they are raising them and *whether they expect to keep doing so*.
segments.tr: Beige Book membantu menjelaskan *mengapa* bisnis mengatakan mereka menaikkannya dan *apakah mereka berencana terus melakukannya*.

segments.src: If the numbers and the stories agree, confidence rises.

segments.src: ### 1. Tariffs
segments.tr: ### 1. Tarif

segments.tr: Karena tarif memengaruhi barang yang menjadi bahan bagi barang lain, dampaknya bisa muncul jauh melampaui barang impor itu sendiri.

segments.src: ### 2. The Iran conflict
segments.tr: ### 2. Konflik Iran

segments.src: ### 3. The AI building boom
segments.tr: ### 3. Ledakan pembangunan AI

segments.src: It is demand-driven rather than supply-driven.

segments.src: In districts with heavy data center activity, contacts describe tighter supplies and higher costs for those inputs, and the effects can spill over to other builders and local utilities.
segments.tr: Di distrik dengan aktivitas pusat data yang padat, narasumber menggambarkan pasokan yang lebih ketat dan biaya yang lebih tinggi untuk input tersebut, dan dampaknya bisa meluas ke pembangun lain serta utilitas lokal.

ja.title: ベージュブックを読む：FRBの現場報告が粘り強い物価を関税・戦争・AI投資と結びつける理由

segments.src: Eight times a year, the Federal Reserve publishes a document that looks nothing like a typical economic release.
segments.tr: FRB（米連邦準備制度）は年8回、一般的な経済指標とはまったく似ていない文書を公表します。

segments.src: There are no charts full of decimal points and no single headline number.
segments.tr: 小数点だらけのグラフも、単一の見出し数字もありません。

segments.src: Instead, the Beige Book is a plain-language collection of stories from business owners, bankers and community contacts across the country.
segments.tr: ベージュブックは、全国の企業経営者、銀行関係者、地域の関係者から集めた話を平易な言葉でまとめたものです。

segments.src: The latest edition draws attention because several of those stories point the same way: prices are proving harder to tame, and contacts keep naming three sources of pressure, which are tariffs, the conflict involving Iran and the boom in AI-related construction and equipment.
segments.tr: 最新版が注目されるのは、いくつもの話が同じ方向を指しているためです。物価は抑えにくくなっており、関係者は「関税」「イラン情勢」「AI関連の建設・設備投資ブーム」という3つの圧力を繰り返し挙げています。

segments.src: This article explains what the Beige Book is, why it matters even though it is not "hard data," and how to read its themes without overreading them.
segments.tr: この記事では、ベージュブックとは何か、「ハードデータ」ではないのになぜ重要なのか、そしてその主題をどう読めば行き過ぎた解釈を避けられるかを説明します。

segments.src: ## What the Beige Book actually is
segments.tr: ## ベージュブックの実際の姿

segments.src: The Beige Book's formal title is the *Summary of Commentary on Current Economic Conditions by Federal Reserve District*.
segments.tr: ベージュブックの正式名称は*Summary of Commentary on Current Economic Conditions by Federal Reserve District*（連邦準備区別の現在の経済情勢に関する意見の要約）です。

segments.src: It is compiled by the 12 regional Federal Reserve Banks, each covering its own part of the country.
segments.tr: 12の地区連邦準備銀行がそれぞれ担当地域を受け持ち、共同でまとめています。

segments.src: Staff at each Bank talk with business executives, economists, market experts and other contacts, then summarize what they hear.
segments.tr: 各銀行のスタッフは、企業幹部、エコノミスト、市場専門家などの関係者と話し、聞いた内容を要約します。

segments.src: The reports are combined into a national overview and released about two weeks before each meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), the group that sets interest rate policy.
segments.tr: 各地区の報告は全国的な概要にまとめられ、金利政策を決定するFOMC（連邦公開市場委員会）の会合のおよそ2週間前に公表されます。

segments.src: Key features:
segments.tr: 主な特徴：

segments.src: - **It is qualitative.** The text describes conditions as "modest," "moderate," "slight" or "strong" rather than giving precise measurements.
segments.tr: - **定性的であること。** 正確な数値ではなく、状況を「modest（緩やか）」「moderate（中程度）」「slight（わずか）」「strong（強い）」といった言葉で表現します。

segments.src: - **It is anecdotal by design.** The value lies in firsthand accounts: what a manufacturer is paying for steel, what a retailer plans to do about shelf prices, what a lender sees in loan demand.
segments.tr: - **意図的に逸話的であること。** 価値は当事者の生の声にあります。製造業者が鉄鋼にいくら払っているか、小売業者が店頭価格にどう対応する計画か、貸し手が融資需要をどう見ているかなどです。

segments.src: - **It is timely.** Government statistics often arrive with a lag and are revised later. The Beige Book captures sentiment as it forms.
segments.tr: - **タイムリーであること。** 政府統計は遅れて発表され、後に改定されることも多いです。ベージュブックは、景気の空気が形成されていく過程を捉えます。

segments.src: - **It is regional.** National averages can hide differences. A port-heavy district may feel tariffs differently than a farm-heavy one.
segments.tr: - **地域的であること。** 全国平均では地域差が見えなくなることがあります。港湾が多い地区と農業が盛んな地区では、関税の受け止め方が異なる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## How it differs from hard data
segments.tr: ## ハードデータとの違い

segments.src: Official data such as the Consumer Price Index (CPI), the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index and the jobs report are built from large, systematic surveys and statistical methods.
segments.tr: 消費者物価指数（CPI）、個人消費支出（PCE）物価指数、雇用統計などの公式データは、大規模で体系的な調査と統計手法に基づいて作成されます。

segments.src: They can be compared month to month and year to year.
segments.tr: 月ごと、年ごとに比較できます。

segments.src: That is their strength.
segments.tr: それがこれらのデータの強みです。

segments.src: The Beige Book trades precision for context.
segments.tr: ベージュブックは、精度と引き換えに文脈を提供します。

segments.src: Hard data tells policymakers *how much* prices rose.
segments.tr: ハードデータは、政策担当者に物価が*どれほど*上がったかを示します。

segments.src: The Beige Book helps explain *why* businesses say they are raising them and *whether they expect to keep doing so*.
segments.tr: ベージュブックは、企業がなぜ価格を上げると言っているのか、そして今後も上げ続けるつもりなのかを説明する助けになります。

segments.src: | | Hard data (CPI, PCE, jobs) | Beige Book |
segments.tr: | | ハードデータ（CPI、PCE、雇用統計） | ベージュブック |

segments.src: | Form | Numbers and indexes | Narrative summaries |
segments.tr: | 形式 | 数値と指数 | 叙述的な要約 |

segments.src: | Method | Statistical sampling | Interviews and conversations |
segments.tr: | 手法 | 統計的サンプリング | 聞き取りと対話 |

segments.src: | Strength | Comparable and measurable | Timely and explanatory |
segments.tr: | 強み | 比較可能で測定しやすい | タイムリーで説明的 |

segments.src: | Weakness | Lagging and revised | Subjective and hard to quantify |
segments.tr: | 弱み | 遅行して改定される | 主観的で定量化しにくい |

segments.src: Neither source is better on its own.
segments.tr: どちらの情報源が単独で優れているわけではありません。

segments.src: Policymakers use both, and the Beige Book often works as a cross-check.
segments.tr: 政策担当者は両方を使い、ベージュブックはしばしばクロスチェックの役割を果たします。

segments.src: If the numbers and the stories agree, confidence rises.
segments.tr: 数値と話が一致すれば、確信は高まります。

segments.src: If they diverge, that is a reason to look closer.
segments.tr: 食い違えば、より詳しく調べる理由になります。

segments.src: ## The three pressures contacts keep naming
segments.tr: ## 関係者が繰り返し挙げる3つの圧力

segments.src: ### 1. Tariffs
Businesses in many districts have described import taxes as a direct cost.
segments.tr: 多くの地区の企業が、輸入関税を直接的なコストとして説明しています。

segments.src: The pattern commonly reported is that firms first absorb higher input costs, then pass part of them to customers, often in stages.
segments.tr: よく報告される傾向は、企業がまず投入コストの上昇を吸収し、その後一部を段階的に顧客へ転嫁するというものです。

segments.src: Some contacts say they have diversified suppliers, but switching sources takes time and can itself raise costs.
segments.tr: 調達先を分散したという関係者もいますが、仕入れ先の切り替えには時間がかかり、それ自体がコストを押し上げることもあります。

segments.src: Because tariffs affect goods that feed into other goods, the effect can show up well beyond the imported item itself.
segments.tr: 関税は他の製品の原材料になる財にも影響するため、その効果は輸入品そのものをはるかに超えて表れることがあります。

segments.src: ### 2. The Iran conflict
segments.tr: ### 2. イラン情勢

segments.src: Geopolitical conflict affects prices mainly through energy and shipping.
segments.tr: 地政学的な紛争は、主にエネルギーと海運を通じて物価に影響します。

segments.src: When tensions threaten oil supply or raise insurance and rerouting costs for freight, fuel and transportation expenses rise, and those costs are embedded in nearly everything that is made or moved.
segments.tr: 緊張によって石油供給が脅かされたり、貨物の保険料や迂回ルートのコストが上がったりすると、燃料費と輸送費が上昇します。その費用は、製造や輸送がかかわるほぼすべてのものに組み込まれています。

segments.src: Contacts who report higher fuel or logistics bills tend to describe them as hard to predict, which makes long-term pricing decisions harder.
segments.tr: 燃料や物流費の上昇を報告する関係者は、それらを予測しにくいと表現する傾向があり、そのため長期的な価格決定が難しくなります。

segments.src: ### 3. The AI building boom
segments.tr: ### 3. AIの建設ブーム

segments.src: The rush to build data centers and buy computing hardware is a different kind of pressure.
segments.tr: データセンターの建設やコンピューティング機器の購入ラッシュは、別の種類の圧力です。

segments.src: It is demand-driven rather than supply-driven.
segments.tr: これは供給側ではなく需要側から生じるものです。

segments.src: Large projects compete for electricians, construction materials, electrical equipment and power capacity.
segments.tr: 大規模プロジェクトは、電気工事士、建設資材、電気設備、電力容量を奪い合います。

segments.src: In districts with heavy data center activity, contacts describe tighter supplies and higher costs for those inputs, and the effects can spill over to other builders and local utilities.
segments.tr: データセンターの活動が盛んな地区では、関係者がこれらの投入材の供給逼迫とコスト上昇を指摘しており、その影響は他の建設業者や地域の電力会社にも波及しています。

segments.src: ## What businesses are telling the central bank
segments.tr: ## 企業が中央銀行に伝えていること

segments.src: Across these themes, the message in the report is less about a single shock than about layering.
segments.tr: これらの主題を通じて、報告書のメッセージは単一のショックというより、複数の要因の重なりにあります。

segments.src: Each source of cost pressure is manageable on its own.
segments.tr: それぞれのコスト圧力は、単独であれば対処可能です。

segments.src: Together, they make it harder for firms to say that price increases are behind them.
segments.tr: しかし、それらが合わさると、企業が価格上昇は終わったと言い切ることが難しくなります。

segments.src: Common threads in this kind of commentary include:
segments.tr: この種の報告に共通する傾向は次のとおりです。

segments.src: - Firms say they are passing through costs more selectively, since consumers have become more price-sensitive.
segments.tr: - 消費者の価格への敏感さが高まっているため、企業はコストの転嫁を以前より選択的に行っている。

segments.src: - Many describe uncertainty as the main obstacle to planning, which can delay hiring and investment.
segments.tr: - 多くの企業が、計画を立てるうえでの最大の障害として不確実性を挙げており、それが採用や投資を遅らせる可能性がある。

segments.src: - Wage pressure is often described as moderate, which may limit how much cost growth is built into prices from the labor side.
segments.tr: - 賃金上昇圧力は中程度と表現されることが多く、労働面から価格に組み込まれるコスト増加を抑える可能性がある。

segments.src: - Consumers are described as shifting toward discounts and cheaper options, especially lower- and middle-income households.
segments.tr: - 消費者は割引品や安価な選択肢へ移行していると描写されており、特に低所得層と中所得層でその傾向が強い。

segments.src: Readers should check the full text of the latest release on the Federal Reserve's website, since the emphasis varies from district to district and edition to edition.
segments.tr: 強調点は地区や版によって異なるため、読者は連邦準備制度のウェブサイトで最新版の全文を確認してください。

segments.src: ## Why it matters for interest rates
segments.tr: ## 金利にとっての意味

segments.src: The Fed's job is to balance stable prices against maximum employment.
segments.tr: FRBの役割は、物価の安定と最大雇用のバランスを取ることです。

segments.src: When inflation stays above target while the labor market cools, that balance gets difficult.
segments.tr: 労働市場が冷え込む一方で、インフレ率が目標を上回り続けると、そのバランスを保つのは難しくなります。

segments.src: A Beige Book that describes persistent price pressure gives policymakers a reason to be cautious about cutting rates too quickly.
segments.tr: 持続的な価格圧力を描くベージュブックは、政策担当者に利下げを急ぎすぎないよう慎重になる理由を与えます。

segments.src: A Beige Book that shows weakening demand and fading pricing power can argue the other way.
segments.tr: 一方、需要の弱まりと価格決定力の低下を示すベージュブックは、逆の結論を後押しする可能性があります。

segments.src: The report does not set policy.
segments.tr: この報告書自体が政策を決めるわけではありません。

segments.src: It is one input among many, alongside inflation readings, employment data, financial conditions and the FOMC's own projections.
segments.tr: インフレ指標、雇用データ、金融環境、FOMC自身の見通しなどと並ぶ、多くの判断材料の一つにすぎません。

segments.src: ## How to read it sensibly
segments.tr: ## 賢く読むための方法

segments.src: 1. **Look for repeated themes, not single quotes.** One company's experience is an anecdote. The same story from several districts is a signal.
segments.tr: 1. **単発の発言ではなく、繰り返される主題に注目する。** 一社の経験は逸話にすぎません。複数の地区で同じ話が出ていれば、それはシグナルです。

segments.src: 2. **Notice changes in wording.** A move from "modest" to "moderate" price growth is small but meaningful in context.
segments.tr: 2. **表現の変化に気づく。** 物価上昇の表現が「modest」から「moderate」に変わるのは小さな変化ですが、文脈の中では意味があります。

segments.src: 3. **Compare with hard data.** See whether the latest CPI and PCE figures are consistent with what contacts report.
segments.tr: 3. **ハードデータと比較する。** 最新のCPIとPCEの数値が、関係者の報告と整合しているかを確認しましょう。

segments.src: 4. **Remember its limits.** Contacts are not a random sample, and sentiment can shift quickly.
segments.tr: 4. **その限界を忘れない。** 関係者は無作為抽出されたサンプルではなく、景気の空気は急速に変わることがあります。

segments.src: ## The takeaway
segments.tr: ## まとめ

segments.src: The Beige Book will not tell you the exact path of inflation or interest rates.
segments.tr: ベージュブックは、インフレや金利の正確な道筋を教えてはくれません。

segments.src: What it does offer is a view from the ground, and the latest one suggests businesses see several overlapping reasons why prices are not settling down: trade policy, geopolitical risk and a surge in AI-related investment.
segments.tr: その代わりに、現場からの視点を提供します。そして最新版は、物価が落ち着かない理由として、通商政策、地政学的リスク、AI関連投資の急増という複数の要因が重なっていると企業が見ていることを示しています。

segments.src: Whether those pressures fade or persist will show up in the data in coming months.
segments.tr: これらの圧力が和らぐのか、続くのかは、今後数か月のデータに表れるでしょう。

segments.tr: *本記事は一般的な情報提供のみを目的としており、金融または投資に関する助言ではありません。*

segments.tr: Entscheidungsträger nutzen beide, und das Beige Book dient oft als Gegenprobe.

segments.src: If the numbers and the stories agree, confidence rises.
segments.tr: Stimmen Zahlen und Berichte überein, steigt das Vertrauen.

segments.src: If they diverge, that is a reason to look closer.
segments.tr: Weichen sie voneinander ab, ist das ein Anlass, genauer hinzusehen.

segments.src: ## The three pressures contacts keep naming
segments.tr: ## Die drei Belastungen, die die Kontakte immer wieder nennen

segments.src: ### 1. Tariffs
segments.tr: ### 1. Zölle

segments.src: Businesses in many districts have described import taxes as a direct cost.
segments.tr: Unternehmen in vielen Distrikten beschreiben Importzölle als direkte Kosten.

segments.src: The pattern commonly reported is that firms first absorb higher input costs, then pass part of them to customers, often in stages.
segments.tr: Typisch berichtet wird folgendes Muster: Firmen tragen zunächst höhere Vorleistungskosten und geben einen Teil davon dann schrittweise an die Kunden weiter.

segments.src: Some contacts say they have diversified suppliers, but switching sources takes time and can itself raise costs.
segments.tr: Einige Kontakte sagen, sie hätten ihre Lieferanten diversifiziert, doch ein Lieferantenwechsel braucht Zeit und kann selbst die Kosten erhöhen.

segments.src: Because tariffs affect goods that feed into other goods, the effect can show up well beyond the imported item itself.
segments.tr: Da Zölle Waren treffen, die in andere Waren einfließen, kann sich die Wirkung weit über den importierten Artikel selbst hinaus zeigen.

segments.src: ### 2. The Iran conflict
segments.tr: ### 2. Der Iran-Konflikt

segments.src: Geopolitical conflict affects prices mainly through energy and shipping.
segments.tr: Geopolitische Konflikte wirken auf die Preise vor allem über Energie und Transport.

segments.src: When tensions threaten oil supply or raise insurance and rerouting costs for freight, fuel and transportation expenses rise, and those costs are embedded in nearly everything that is made or moved.
segments.tr: Wenn Spannungen die Ölversorgung bedrohen oder Versicherungs- und Umleitungskosten für Fracht erhöhen, steigen Kraftstoff- und Transportausgaben, und diese Kosten stecken in nahezu allem, was hergestellt oder transportiert wird.

segments.src: Contacts who report higher fuel or logistics bills tend to describe them as hard to predict, which makes long-term pricing decisions harder.
segments.tr: Kontakte, die höhere Kraftstoff- oder Logistikrechnungen melden, beschreiben sie meist als schwer vorhersehbar, was langfristige Preisentscheidungen erschwert.

segments.src: ### 3. The AI building boom
segments.tr: ### 3. Der KI-Bauboom

segments.src: The rush to build data centers and buy computing hardware is a different kind of pressure.
segments.tr: Der Wettlauf um den Bau von Rechenzentren und den Kauf von Computerhardware ist eine andere Art von Druck.

segments.src: It is demand-driven rather than supply-driven.
segments.tr: Er ist nachfragegetrieben statt angebotsgetrieben.

segments.src: Large projects compete for electricians, construction materials, electrical equipment and power capacity.
segments.tr: Große Projekte konkurrieren um Elektriker, Baumaterialien, elektrische Ausrüstung und Stromkapazität.

segments.src: In districts with heavy data center activity, contacts describe tighter supplies and higher costs for those inputs, and the effects can spill over to other builders and local utilities.
segments.tr: In Distrikten mit viel Rechenzentrumsaktivität beschreiben Kontakte knappere Versorgung und höhere Kosten für diese Vorleistungen, und die Effekte können auf andere Bauunternehmen und lokale Versorger übergreifen.

segments.src: ## What businesses are telling the central bank
segments.tr: ## Was Unternehmen der Zentralbank mitteilen

segments.src: Across these themes, the message in the report is less about a single shock than about layering.
segments.tr: Über diese Themen hinweg liegt die Botschaft des Berichts weniger in einem einzelnen Schock als in der Überlagerung.

segments.src: Each source of cost pressure is manageable on its own.
segments.tr: Jeder einzelne Kostendruck wäre für sich beherrschbar.

segments.src: Together, they make it harder for firms to say that price increases are behind them.
segments.tr: Zusammen erschweren sie es den Firmen zu sagen, dass die Preissteigerungen hinter ihnen liegen.

segments.src: Common threads in this kind of commentary include:
segments.tr: Gemeinsame Linien in dieser Art von Kommentaren sind unter anderem:

segments.src: - Firms say they are passing through costs more selectively, since consumers have become more price-sensitive.
segments.tr: - Firmen sagen, sie gäben Kosten selektiver weiter, da die Verbraucher preissensibler geworden sind.

segments.src: - Many describe uncertainty as the main obstacle to planning, which can delay hiring and investment.
segments.tr: - Viele beschreiben Unsicherheit als Haupthindernis für die Planung, was Einstellungen und Investitionen verzögern kann.

segments.src: - Wage pressure is often described as moderate, which may limit how much cost growth is built into prices from the labor side.
segments.tr: - Der Lohndruck wird oft als moderat beschrieben, was einschränken kann, wie viel Kostenwachstum auf der Arbeitsseite in die Preise eingepreist wird.

segments.src: - Consumers are described as shifting toward discounts and cheaper options, especially lower- and middle-income households.
segments.tr: - Verbraucher wenden sich laut Beschreibung verstärkt Rabatten und günstigeren Angeboten zu, besonders Haushalte mit niedrigem und mittlerem Einkommen.

segments.src: Readers should check the full text of the latest release on the Federal Reserve's website, since the emphasis varies from district to district and edition to edition.
segments.tr: Leser sollten den vollständigen Text der jüngsten Veröffentlichung auf der Website der Federal Reserve prüfen, da die Schwerpunkte von Distrikt zu Distrikt und von Ausgabe zu Ausgabe variieren.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for interest rates
segments.tr: ## Warum es für die Zinsen wichtig ist

segments.src: The Fed's job is to balance stable prices against maximum employment.
segments.tr: Die Aufgabe der Fed ist es, stabile Preise und maximale Beschäftigung in Einklang zu bringen.

segments.src: When inflation stays above target while the labor market cools, that balance gets difficult.
segments.tr: Bleibt die Inflation über dem Ziel, während sich der Arbeitsmarkt abkühlt, wird dieses Gleichgewicht schwierig.

segments.src: A Beige Book that describes persistent price pressure gives policymakers a reason to be cautious about cutting rates too quickly.
segments.tr: Ein Beige Book, das anhaltenden Preisdruck beschreibt, gibt den Entscheidungsträgern Anlass, bei Zinssenkungen nicht zu schnell vorzugehen.

segments.src: A Beige Book that shows weakening demand and fading pricing power can argue the other way.
segments.tr: Ein Beige Book, das schwächere Nachfrage und nachlassende Preissetzungsmacht zeigt, kann in die Gegenrichtung argumentieren.

segments.src: The report does not set policy.
segments.tr: Der Bericht legt die Politik nicht fest.

segments.src: It is one input among many, alongside inflation readings, employment data, financial conditions and the FOMC's own projections.
segments.tr: Er ist ein Input unter vielen, neben Inflationsdaten, Beschäftigungszahlen, Finanzbedingungen und den eigenen Projektionen des FOMC.

segments.src: ## How to read it sensibly
segments.tr: ## Wie man es sinnvoll liest

segments.src: 1. **Look for repeated themes, not single quotes.** One company's experience is an anecdote. The same story from several districts is a signal.
segments.tr: 1. **Achten Sie auf wiederkehrende Themen statt auf einzelne Zitate.** Die Erfahrung eines Unternehmens ist eine Anekdote. Dieselbe Geschichte aus mehreren Distrikten ist ein Signal.

segments.src: 2. **Notice changes in wording.** A move from "modest" to "moderate" price growth is small but meaningful in context.
segments.tr: 2. **Achten Sie auf Änderungen im Wortlaut.** Ein Wechsel von „gering“ zu „moderat“ beim Preisanstieg ist klein, im Kontext aber bedeutsam.

segments.src: 3. **Compare with hard data.** See whether the latest CPI and PCE figures are consistent with what contacts report.
segments.tr: 3. **Vergleichen Sie mit harten Daten.** Prüfen Sie, ob die aktuellen CPI- und PCE-Werte mit dem übereinstimmen, was die Kontakte berichten.

segments.src: 4. **Remember its limits.** Contacts are not a random sample, and sentiment can shift quickly.
segments.tr: 4. **Denken Sie an die Grenzen.** Die Kontakte sind keine Zufallsstichprobe, und die Stimmung kann sich schnell ändern.

segments.src: ## The takeaway
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The Beige Book will not tell you the exact path of inflation or interest rates.
segments.tr: Das Beige Book verrät nicht den genauen Verlauf der Inflation oder der Zinsen.

segments.src: What it does offer is a view from the ground, and the latest one suggests businesses see several overlapping reasons why prices are not settling down: trade policy, geopolitical risk and a surge in AI-related investment.
segments.tr: Es bietet aber eine Sicht von der Basis, und die jüngste zeigt, dass Unternehmen mehrere sich überlagernde Gründe sehen, warum sich die Preise nicht beruhigen: Handelspolitik, geopolitische Risiken und ein Anstieg der KI-bezogenen Investitionen.

segments.src: Whether those pressures fade or persist will show up in the data in coming months.
segments.tr: Ob diese Belastungen abklingen oder anhalten, wird sich in den kommenden Monaten in den Daten zeigen.

vi.title: Đọc Beige Book: Vì sao báo cáo mang tính giai thoại của Fed lại liên kết giá cả dai dẳng với thuế quan, chiến tranh và chi tiêu cho AI

segments.src: Eight times a year, the Federal Reserve publishes a document that looks nothing like a typical economic release.
segments.tr: Tám lần mỗi năm, Cục Dự trữ Liên bang Mỹ (Fed) công bố một tài liệu trông hoàn toàn khác với các báo cáo kinh tế thông thường.

segments.src: There are no charts full of decimal points and no single headline number.
segments.tr: Không có biểu đồ đầy những con số thập phân, cũng không có con số tiêu đề duy nhất.

segments.src: Instead, the Beige Book is a plain-language collection of stories from business owners, bankers and community contacts across the country.
segments.tr: Thay vào đó, Beige Book là tập hợp các câu chuyện được viết bằng ngôn ngữ dễ hiểu, từ chủ doanh nghiệp, ngân hàng và các đầu mối trong cộng đồng trên khắp cả nước.

segments.src: The latest edition draws attention because several of those stories point the same way: prices are proving harder to tame, and contacts keep naming three sources of pressure, which are tariffs, the conflict involving Iran and the boom in AI-related construction and equipment.
segments.tr: Ấn bản mới nhất thu hút sự chú ý vì nhiều câu chuyện trong đó cùng chỉ về một hướng: giá cả ngày càng khó kiềm chế, và các đầu mối liên tục nhắc đến ba nguồn áp lực là thuế quan, xung đột liên quan đến Iran và làn sóng đầu tư xây dựng cùng thiết bị phục vụ AI.

segments.src: This article explains what the Beige Book is, why it matters even though it is not "hard data," and how to read its themes without overreading them.
segments.tr: Bài viết này giải thích Beige Book là gì, vì sao nó quan trọng dù không phải là "dữ liệu cứng", và cách đọc các chủ đề trong đó mà không suy diễn quá mức.

segments.src: ## What the Beige Book actually is
segments.tr: ## Beige Book thực chất là gì

segments.src: The Beige Book's formal title is the *Summary of Commentary on Current Economic Conditions by Federal Reserve District*.
segments.tr: Tên chính thức của Beige Book là *Summary of Commentary on Current Economic Conditions by Federal Reserve District* (Tóm tắt nhận định về tình hình kinh tế hiện tại theo từng khu vực của Cục Dự trữ Liên bang).

segments.src: It is compiled by the 12 regional Federal Reserve Banks, each covering its own part of the country.
segments.tr: Báo cáo do 12 Ngân hàng Dự trữ Liên bang khu vực tổng hợp, mỗi ngân hàng phụ trách một khu vực của đất nước.

segments.src: Staff at each Bank talk with business executives, economists, market experts and other contacts, then summarize what they hear.
segments.tr: Nhân viên tại mỗi ngân hàng trao đổi với các lãnh đạo doanh nghiệp, nhà kinh tế, chuyên gia thị trường và các đầu mối khác, sau đó tóm tắt những gì họ nghe được.

segments.src: The reports are combined into a national overview and released about two weeks before each meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), the group that sets interest rate policy.
segments.tr: Các báo cáo được gộp thành một bức tranh toàn quốc và được công bố khoảng hai tuần trước mỗi cuộc họp của Ủy ban Thị trường Mở Liên bang (FOMC), nhóm có thẩm quyền quyết định chính sách lãi suất.

segments.src: Key features:
segments.tr: Các đặc điểm chính:

segments.src: - **It is qualitative.** The text describes conditions as "modest," "moderate," "slight" or "strong" rather than giving precise measurements.
segments.tr: - **Mang tính định tính.** Văn bản mô tả tình hình bằng các từ như "modest", "moderate", "slight" hay "strong" (lần lượt là vừa phải, trung bình, nhẹ, mạnh) thay vì đưa ra số đo chính xác.

segments.src: - **It is anecdotal by design.** The value lies in firsthand accounts: what a manufacturer is paying for steel, what a retailer plans to do about shelf prices, what a lender sees in loan demand.
segments.tr: - **Mang tính giai thoại theo thiết kế.** Giá trị nằm ở các trải nghiệm trực tiếp: một nhà sản xuất đang trả bao nhiêu cho thép, một nhà bán lẻ dự định làm gì với giá trên kệ hàng, hay một ngân hàng cho vay thấy nhu cầu vay vốn ra sao.

segments.src: - **It is timely.** Government statistics often arrive with a lag and are revised later. The Beige Book captures sentiment as it forms.
segments.tr: - **Mang tính kịp thời.** Số liệu thống kê chính thức thường đến muộn và được điều chỉnh sau đó. Beige Book ghi nhận tâm lý thị trường ngay khi nó hình thành.

segments.src: - **It is regional.** National averages can hide differences. A port-heavy district may feel tariffs differently than a farm-heavy one.
segments.tr: - **Mang tính khu vực.** Số liệu trung bình toàn quốc có thể che giấu sự khác biệt. Một khu vực có nhiều cảng có thể cảm nhận thuế quan khác với một khu vực nông nghiệp.

segments.src: ## How it differs from hard data
segments.tr: ## Khác biệt so với dữ liệu cứng

segments.src: Official data such as the Consumer Price Index (CPI), the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index and the jobs report are built from large, systematic surveys and statistical methods.
segments.tr: Dữ liệu chính thức như Chỉ số giá tiêu dùng (CPI), chỉ số giá chi tiêu tiêu dùng cá nhân (PCE) và báo cáo việc làm được xây dựng từ các cuộc khảo sát quy mô lớn, có hệ thống và các phương pháp thống kê.

segments.src: They can be compared month to month and year to year.
segments.tr: Chúng có thể so sánh theo từng tháng và từng năm.

segments.src: That is their strength.
segments.tr: Đó là điểm mạnh của chúng.

segments.src: The Beige Book trades precision for context.
segments.tr: Beige Book đánh đổi độ chính xác lấy bối cảnh.

segments.src: Hard data tells policymakers *how much* prices rose.
segments.tr: Dữ liệu cứng cho các nhà hoạch định chính sách biết giá *tăng bao nhiêu*.

segments.src: The Beige Book helps explain *why* businesses say they are raising them and *whether they expect to keep doing so*.
segments.tr: Beige Book giúp giải thích *vì sao* doanh nghiệp nói họ đang tăng giá và *liệu họ có dự định tiếp tục làm vậy hay không*.

segments.src: ## The three pressures contacts keep naming
segments.tr: ## Ba áp lực mà các đầu mối liên tục nhắc đến

segments.src: ### 1. Tariffs
segments.tr: ### 1. Thuế quan

segments.src: Businesses in many districts have described import taxes as a direct cost.
segments.tr: Doanh nghiệp ở nhiều khu vực mô tả thuế nhập khẩu là một khoản chi phí trực tiếp.

segments.src: The pattern commonly reported is that firms first absorb higher input costs, then pass part of them to customers, often in stages.
segments.tr: Mô hình thường được ghi nhận là các công ty trước tiên hấp thụ chi phí đầu vào tăng, sau đó chuyển một phần sang khách hàng, thường theo từng bước.

segments.src: Some contacts say they have diversified suppliers, but switching sources takes time and can itself raise costs.
segments.tr: Một số đầu mối cho biết họ đã đa dạng hóa nhà cung cấp, nhưng việc chuyển nguồn cung mất thời gian và bản thân nó cũng có thể làm tăng chi phí.

segments.src: Because tariffs affect goods that feed into other goods, the effect can show up well beyond the imported item itself.
segments.tr: Vì thuế quan ảnh hưởng đến hàng hóa là nguyên liệu của các hàng hóa khác, tác động có thể lan xa hơn nhiều so với chính mặt hàng nhập khẩu.

segments.src: ### 2. The Iran conflict
segments.tr: ### 2. Xung đột tại Iran

segments.src: Geopolitical conflict affects prices mainly through energy and shipping.
segments.tr: Xung đột địa chính trị ảnh hưởng đến giá cả chủ yếu thông qua năng lượng và vận tải biển.

segments.src: When tensions threaten oil supply or raise insurance and rerouting costs for freight, fuel and transportation expenses rise, and those costs are embedded in nearly everything that is made or moved.
segments.tr: Khi căng thẳng đe dọa nguồn cung dầu hoặc làm tăng phí bảo hiểm và chi phí định tuyến lại cho hàng hóa vận chuyển, chi phí nhiên liệu và logistics tăng lên, và các khoản chi phí này được tích hợp vào hầu hết mọi thứ được sản xuất hoặc vận chuyển.

segments.src: Contacts who report higher fuel or logistics bills tend to describe them as hard to predict, which makes long-term pricing decisions harder.
segments.tr: Những đầu mối cho biết hóa đơn nhiên liệu hoặc logistics tăng thường mô tả chúng là khó dự đoán, khiến các quyết định định giá dài hạn trở nên khó khăn hơn.

segments.src: ### 3. The AI building boom
segments.tr: ### 3. Làn sóng xây dựng AI

segments.src: The rush to build data centers and buy computing hardware is a different kind of pressure.
segments.tr: Cuộc chạy đua xây dựng trung tâm dữ liệu và mua phần cứng máy tính là một loại áp lực khác.

segments.src: It is demand-driven rather than supply-driven.
segments.tr: Nó được thúc đẩy bởi cầu hơn là cung.

segments.src: Large projects compete for electricians, construction materials, electrical equipment and power capacity.
segments.tr: Các dự án lớn cạnh tranh về thợ điện, vật liệu xây dựng, thiết bị điện và công suất điện.

segments.src: In districts with heavy data center activity, contacts describe tighter supplies and higher costs for those inputs, and the effects can spill over to other builders and local utilities.
segments.tr: Ở các khu vực có nhiều hoạt động trung tâm dữ liệu, các đầu mối mô tả nguồn cung thắt chặt và chi phí đầu vào cao hơn, và các tác động có thể lan sang các nhà thầu khác và đơn vị điện lực địa phương.

segments.src: ## What businesses are telling the central bank
segments.tr: ## Doanh nghiệp đang nói gì với ngân hàng trung ương

segments.src: Across these themes, the message in the report is less about a single shock than about layering.
segments.tr: Xuyên suốt các chủ đề này, thông điệp của báo cáo không nằm ở một cú sốc đơn lẻ mà ở việc các áp lực chồng lên nhau.

segments.src: Each source of cost pressure is manageable on its own.
segments.tr: Mỗi nguồn áp lực chi phí riêng lẻ đều có thể kiểm soát được.

segments.src: Together, they make it harder for firms to say that price increases are behind them.
segments.tr: Gộp lại, chúng khiến doanh nghiệp khó nói rằng đợt tăng giá đã qua.

segments.src: Common threads in this kind of commentary include:
segments.tr: Các chủ đề chung trong loại nhận định này bao gồm:

segments.src: - Firms say they are passing through costs more selectively, since consumers have become more price-sensitive.
segments.tr: - Doanh nghiệp cho biết họ chuyển chi phí sang giá một cách có chọn lọc hơn, vì người tiêu dùng đã nhạy cảm hơn với giá.

segments.src: - Many describe uncertainty as the main obstacle to planning, which can delay hiring and investment.
segments.tr: - Nhiều người mô tả sự bất định là trở ngại chính cho việc lập kế hoạch, và có thể làm chậm tuyển dụng và đầu tư.

segments.src: - Wage pressure is often described as moderate, which may limit how much cost growth is built into prices from the labor side.
segments.tr: - Áp lực tiền lương thường được mô tả ở mức vừa phải, điều này có thể hạn chế mức độ chi phí lao động được đưa vào giá.

segments.src: - Consumers are described as shifting toward discounts and cheaper options, especially lower- and middle-income households.
segments.tr: - Người tiêu dùng được mô tả là chuyển sang các mặt hàng giảm giá và rẻ hơn, đặc biệt là các hộ gia đình thu nhập thấp và trung bình.

segments.src: Readers should check the full text of the latest release on the Federal Reserve's website, since the emphasis varies from district to district and edition to edition.
segments.tr: Người đọc nên kiểm tra toàn văn bản phát hành mới nhất trên website của Cục Dự trữ Liên bang, vì trọng tâm khác nhau giữa các khu vực và giữa các ấn bản.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for interest rates
segments.tr: ## Vì sao điều này quan trọng với lãi suất

segments.src: The Fed's job is to balance stable prices against maximum employment.
segments.tr: Nhiệm vụ của Fed là cân bằng giữa ổn định giá cả và việc làm tối đa.

segments.src: When inflation stays above target while the labor market cools, that balance gets difficult.
segments.tr: Khi lạm phát vẫn cao hơn mục tiêu trong khi thị trường lao động nguội dần, sự cân bằng đó trở nên khó khăn.

segments.src: A Beige Book that describes persistent price pressure gives policymakers a reason to be cautious about cutting rates too quickly.
segments.tr: Một Beige Book mô tả áp lực giá dai dẳng sẽ cho các nhà hoạch định chính sách lý do để thận trọng trước việc cắt lãi suất quá nhanh.

segments.src: A Beige Book that shows weakening demand and fading pricing power can argue the other way.
segments.tr: Ngược lại, một Beige Book cho thấy nhu cầu suy yếu và khả năng định giá giảm sút có thể lập luận theo chiều hướng khác.

segments.src: The report does not set policy.
segments.tr: Báo cáo không quyết định chính sách.

segments.src: It is one input among many, alongside inflation readings, employment data, financial conditions and the FOMC's own projections.
segments.tr: Nó là một đầu vào trong số nhiều đầu vào, bên cạnh số liệu lạm phát, dữ liệu việc làm, điều kiện tài chính và các dự báo của chính FOMC.

segments.src: ## How to read it sensibly
segments.tr: ## Cách đọc hợp lý

segments.src: 1. **Look for repeated themes, not single quotes.** One company's experience is an anecdote. The same story from several districts is a signal.
segments.tr: 1. **Tìm các chủ đề lặp lại, không phải các trích dẫn đơn lẻ.** Trải nghiệm của một công ty là một giai thoại. Cùng một câu chuyện từ nhiều khu vực mới là tín hiệu.

segments.src: 2. **Notice changes in wording.** A move from "modest" to "moderate" price growth is small but meaningful in context.
segments.tr: 2. **Chú ý sự thay đổi trong cách diễn đạt.** Việc chuyển từ "modest" sang "moderate" khi nói về tăng giá là thay đổi nhỏ nhưng có ý nghĩa trong bối cảnh.

segments.src: 3. **Compare with hard data.** See whether the latest CPI and PCE figures are consistent with what contacts report.
segments.tr: 3. **So sánh với dữ liệu cứng.** Xem các số liệu CPI và PCE mới nhất có nhất quán với những gì các đầu mối báo cáo hay không.

segments.src: 4. **Remember its limits.** Contacts are not a random sample, and sentiment can shift quickly.
segments.tr: 4. **Nhớ những giới hạn của nó.** Các đầu mối không phải là mẫu ngẫu nhiên, và tâm lý có thể thay đổi nhanh chóng.

segments.src: ## The takeaway
segments.tr: ## Kết luận

segments.src: The Beige Book will not tell you the exact path of inflation or interest rates.
segments.tr: Beige Book sẽ không cho bạn biết chính xác lạm phát hay lãi suất sẽ đi theo hướng nào.

segments.src: What it does offer is a view from the ground, and the latest one suggests businesses see several overlapping reasons why prices are not settling down: trade policy, geopolitical risk and a surge in AI-related investment.
segments.tr: Điều nó mang lại là góc nhìn từ thực tế, và ấn bản mới nhất cho thấy doanh nghiệp thấy nhiều lý do chồng chéo khiến giá cả chưa ổn định: chính sách thương mại, rủi ro địa chính trị và làn sóng đầu tư liên quan đến AI.

segments.src: Whether those pressures fade or persist will show up in the data in coming months.
segments.tr: Việc các áp lực này suy giảm hay kéo dài sẽ thể hiện rõ trong dữ liệu trong những tháng tới.
